topic: National Universal Free and Research Oriented Education Reform Bill

findings.title: Constitution of India, Article 21A, 51A(g), 51A(h)
findings.limitations: Article 21A covers only ages 6 to 14; expansion to ages 3-22 requires central statutory legislation.

findings.title: Right of Children to Free and Compulsory Education Act, 2009
findings.limitations: Restricted scope; lacks R&D spending guarantees and universal pre-primary to higher education coverage.

gaps: Absence of statutory guarantees for free higher/vocational education and practical scientific curriculum.
